subject: Target decision: Claude Sonnet 4.6 with thinking for A1 (Nathan)
body: Nathan chose claude-sonnet-4-6 with thinking as the target whose reasoning the A1 judge reads. Use --llm anthropic --target claude-sonnet-4-6+thinking (commit on main; needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY). Caveats: the API returns SUMMARIZED thinking, not raw chain of thought, so A1 from it is a lower bound; PLAN 4 calls A1 'raw-CoT', so the open-weight Modal target (C2) is still the only raw-reasoning option. Smoke result: Haiku showed 0/40 misbehaviour on the four baseline probes (results/smoke/behavior_gap_2026-11-14.json), so V3 needs a different probe or target. No paid runs are approved yet. C2 (Abhi): please reflect this in configs/models.json.
